facebook_conversions.events.create.description: Submit one or more server-side conversion events to Facebook through the Conversions API. Use this to report purchases, lead captures, and other conversions occurring outside the browser. Supported standard event names include: Purchase, Lead, ViewContent, AddToCart, InitiateCheckout, CompleteRegistration, AddPaymentInfo, Search, Contact, Subscribe.

pixelId.description: The Facebook Pixel ID to associate events with.

access_token.description: Access token for a System User with appropriate permissions.

test_event_code.description: A test code used to validate events in Events Manager without recording real data.

facebook_conversions.events.create.request: Body: {data (required, array of ConversionEvent — list of events to send; each event has: event_name (string), action_source (string), user_data (object with em, ph, fn, ln), custom_data (object with value, currency))}

slack.conversations.list.description: Fetch all conversations in a Slack workspace, paginated and limited by the token's granted scopes.

exclude_archived.description: If true, archived conversations are excluded from results (default false).

types.description: Comma-separated channel type filter: public_channel, private_channel, mpim, im (default 'public_channel').

limit.description: Maximum items per page (hard max 1000, recommended 200 or fewer).

team_id.description: Workspace ID, required only when using an org-level token.

slack.conversations.info.description: Fetch details about a specific conversation. Returns a channel object including topic, purpose, member count, and archive status.

channel.description: ID of the conversation to look up.

include_locale.description: Set true to include the locale for this conversation (default false).

include_num_members.description: Set true to include the member count in the response (default false).

slack.conversations.create.description: Create a new public or private Slack channel. Names must use lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores only (max 80 characters).

name.description: Desired name for the new channel.

is_private.description: Set true to create a private channel rather than a public one (default false).

team_id.description: Workspace ID, required only when using an org-level token.

slack.conversations.invite.description: Add between 1 and 100 users to a public or private channel. The caller must already be a member of the channel.

channel.description: ID of the channel to which users should be added.

users.description: Comma-separated list of user IDs to invite (up to 100).

force.description: When true and multiple users are supplied, continue inviting remaining users even if one fails.

slack.conversations.archive.description: Archive a channel or DM to prevent any further messages from being posted. Not supported for all conversation types.

channel.description: ID of the conversation to archive.

slack.conversations.setTopic.description: Set or replace the topic line shown at the top of a channel. The calling user must be a member of the conversation.

channel.description: ID of the conversation whose topic should be updated.

topic.description: New topic text. Formatting and link expansion are not supported.

slack.conversations.members.description: Get a paginated list of user IDs belonging to a conversation.

channel.description: ID of the conversation whose members should be listed.

limit.description: Maximum members per page (hard max 1000, recommended 200 or fewer).

slack.conversations.history.description: Fetch previous messages and events from a channel or conversation. Results are returned newest-first.

channel.description: ID of the conversation to read history from.

limit.description: Maximum items to return (default 100, hard max 1000, recommended 200 or fewer).

latest.description: Retrieve only messages sent before this Unix timestamp (defaults to now).

oldest.description: Retrieve only messages sent after this Unix timestamp (defaults to 0).

inclusive.description: When true, messages at the exact oldest or latest boundary are included (default false).

slack.conversations.replies.description: Retrieve all messages in a thread, including the original parent and all replies.

channel.description: ID of the conversation containing the thread.

ts.description: Timestamp of the parent message that starts the thread. Must match an existing message.

limit.description: Maximum items per page (hard max 1000, recommended 200 or fewer).

latest.description: Only include messages before this Unix timestamp.

oldest.description: Only include messages after this Unix timestamp.

inclusive.description: When true, messages at the exact oldest or latest boundary are included (default false).

slack.chat.postMessage.description: Send a new message to a channel or direct message. Include thread_ts to post as a reply within an existing thread.

channel.description: Destination channel, private group, or IM. Can be an encoded ID or a channel name.

text.description: Message body text. Required when no blocks or attachments are provided.

blocks.description: Structured Block Kit layout elements as a JSON array.

attachments.description: Legacy secondary message attachments as a JSON array.

thread_ts.description: Timestamp of another message; supply this to make the post a thread reply.

reply_broadcast.description: When used with thread_ts and set true, also posts the reply to the main channel (default false).

unfurl_links.description: Enables link preview expansion for text-based URLs (default false).

unfurl_media.description: Controls media URL expansion; set false to suppress it (default true).

mrkdwn.description: Set false to disable Slack's markdown-style text formatting (default true).

username.description: Override the bot's display name for this message (requires chat:write.customize scope).

icon_emoji.description: Emoji to display as the message icon (e.g. :chart_with_upwards_trend:).

icon_url.description: Image URL to use as the message icon.

slack.chat.update.description: Change the text or block content of a previously posted message.

channel.description: Channel where the message to be changed was posted.

ts.description: Timestamp identifying the message to update.

text.description: Replacement text for the message. Required when blocks and attachments are not supplied.

blocks.description: Replacement Block Kit layout elements as a JSON array.

attachments.description: Replacement legacy attachments as a JSON array.

slack.chat.delete.description: Permanently remove a previously posted message from a channel.

channel.description: Channel containing the message to delete.

ts.description: Timestamp identifying the message to delete.

slack.reactions.add.description: Attach an emoji reaction to a message.

channel.description: Channel where the target message was posted.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the message to react to.

name.description: Emoji name to use as the reaction, without surrounding colons (e.g. 'thumbsup').

slack.reactions.get.description: Retrieve all emoji reactions on a message.

channel.description: Channel where the target message was posted.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of the message whose reactions to retrieve.

full.description: When true, returns the complete list of reacting users.

slack.search.messages.description: Search across messages in the workspace matching a query. Supports in:channel and from:user modifier syntax.

query.description: Search expression. Supports in:channel_name and from:user_id modifiers.

highlight.description: When true, matched terms are highlighted in the returned text.

slack.users.list.description: Enumerate all members of a Slack workspace. Useful for locating a user by display name or real name when their email or ID is unknown.

slack.users.lookupByEmail.description: Look up a workspace member using their email address. Requires the users:read.email scope.

email.description: Email address of the workspace member to find.

slack.users.info.description: Retrieve the profile and account details for a single Slack user.

user.description: ID of the user to look up.

include_locale.description: When true, the user's locale is included in the response (default false).

slack.users.profile.set.description: Update profile fields for a user, such as status text and emoji.

profile.description: Object containing profile fields to update (e.g. status_text, status_emoji, status_expiration).

name.description: Name of a single profile field to set (alternative to supplying the full profile object).

value.description: Value to assign to the single profile field specified by name.

user.description: ID of the user whose profile to update (admin only). Defaults to the authenticated user.

slack.conversations.open.description: Open or resume a direct message or multi-person DM. Use this to obtain a DM channel ID before sending a message with chat.postMessage.

users.description: Comma-separated list of user IDs. A single ID opens a DM; multiple IDs open or resume an MPIM.

channel.description: ID of an existing IM or MPIM channel to resume.

return_im.description: When true, the response includes the full IM channel definition.

trello.members.boards.description: Retrieve all boards belonging to a member. Pass memberId='me' to get the authenticated user's boards. Useful for discovering board IDs by name before querying lists or cards.

memberId.description: The member ID, or 'me' to refer to the authenticated user.

filter.description: Scope of boards to return: all, open, closed, members, organization, public (defaults to open).

trello.cards.create.description: Add a new card to a Trello list.
trello.cards.create.request: Body: {idList (required, string — list ID), name (required, string — card title), desc (optional, string), due (optional, ISO 8601), idBoard (optional, string — board context), pos (optional: 'top'|'bottom'|number)}

trello.boards.lists.description: Retrieve all lists present on a given Trello board.

id.description: Identifier of the board.

filter.description: Scope of lists to return: all, open, closed, none (defaults to all).

trello.boards.cards.description: Retrieve all cards on a given Trello board.

id.description: Identifier of the board.

filter.description: Scope of cards to return: all, closed, none, open, visible (defaults to all).

trello.boards.cards.response: [{id, name, desc, idList, idBoard, due, dueComplete, closed, labels}]

trello.cards.update.description: Edit properties of an existing Trello card. Only include the fields you wish to change; all others remain unchanged.

id.description: The card ID or shortLink.

trello.cards.update.request: Body: {name (optional, string), desc (optional, string), due (optional, ISO 8601 datetime or null), dueComplete (optional, bool), closed (optional, bool — true to archive), idBoard (optional, string — board ID to move card to), idList (optional, string — list ID to move card to), pos (optional: 'top'|'bottom'|number)}
trello.cards.update.response: {id, name, desc, idList, idBoard, due, dueComplete, closed, labels, pos}

trello.cards.addLabel.description: Attach a label to a Trello card using its label ID. Label IDs can be found via GET /1/boards/{id}/labels.

id.description: Identifier of the card.

value.description: The label ID to attach to the card.

trello.cards.comment.description: Post a comment on a Trello card.

id.description: Identifier of the card.

trello.cards.comment.response: {id, type: 'commentCard', date, data: {text, card: {id, name}, board: {id, name}}}

quickbooks.query.get.description: Run a QuickBooks query supplied as a URL parameter. Supports SELECT * or COUNT(*), WHERE conditions joined by AND, LIKE and IN filters, ORDERBY, and pagination with STARTPOSITION and MAXRESULTS.
quickbooks.query.get.response: {QueryResponse: {entity_type: [records], startPosition: int, maxResults: int, totalCount: int}}

quickbooks.query.description: Run a QuickBooks query to find and filter entity records. Supports SELECT * or COUNT(*), WHERE conditions joined by AND, LIKE and IN filters, ORDERBY, and pagination with STARTPOSITION and MAXRESULTS. OR, joins, and grouping are not supported.

quickbooks.query.response: {QueryResponse: {entity_type: [records], startPosition: int, maxResults: int, totalCount: int}}

quickbooks.customer.get.description: Look up one customer record by ID, returning all of its fields.

customerId.description: Unique ID of the customer to retrieve.

quickbooks.customer.create.request: Customer fields: {DisplayName (required), GivenName, MiddleName, FamilyName, CompanyName, Title, Suffix, PrintOnCheckName, Notes, Active, Taxable, Job, BillWithParent, PreferredDeliveryMethod, BillAddr, ShipAddr, PrimaryPhone, Mobile, Fax, PrimaryEmailAddr, WebAddr, DefaultTaxCodeRef, SalesTermRef, PaymentMethodRef, CurrencyRef, ParentRef}

quickbooks.customer.update.description: Modify an existing customer. The request body must include Id and the current SyncToken. Supports sparse updates when sparse is set to true.
quickbooks.customer.update.request: Customer fields to update: {Id (required), SyncToken (required), sparse (optional, boolean), DisplayName, GivenName, FamilyName, CompanyName, Active, Notes, BillAddr, ShipAddr, PrimaryPhone, PrimaryEmailAddr, ...}

quickbooks.vendor.get.description: Fetch a single vendor record by its unique identifier.

quickbooks.vendor.create.description: Register a new vendor. DisplayName must not duplicate any existing customer, vendor, or employee name.
quickbooks.vendor.create.request: Vendor fields: {DisplayName (required), GivenName, MiddleName, FamilyName, CompanyName, Suffix, PrintOnCheckName, Active, Vendor1099, BillRate, AcctNum, TaxIdentifier, BillAddr, PrimaryPhone, Mobile, Fax, PrimaryEmailAddr, WebAddr, TermRef, CurrencyRef}

quickbooks.vendor.update.description: Update an existing vendor record. Must include Id and SyncToken in the request.
quickbooks.vendor.update.request: Vendor fields to update: {Id (required), SyncToken (required), sparse (optional), DisplayName, CompanyName, Active, Vendor1099, BillAddr, PrimaryPhone, PrimaryEmailAddr, TermRef, ...}

quickbooks.account.get.description: Retrieve a single chart-of-accounts entry by its identifier.

quickbooks.account.create.description: Add a new account to the chart of accounts. Name and AccountType are required.
quickbooks.account.create.request: Account fields: {Name (required), AccountType (required - e.g., Bank, Expense, Income, Other Current Asset, Credit Card, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Fixed Asset, Other Current Liability, Equity, Other Income, Other Expense, Cost of Goods Sold), AccountSubType, AcctNum, Description, Active, SubAccount, ParentRef, CurrencyRef}

quickbooks.account.update.description: Modify an existing account. Must include Id and SyncToken.
quickbooks.account.update.request: Account fields to update: {Id (required), SyncToken (required), sparse (optional), Name, AccountType, AccountSubType, AcctNum, Description, Active, ...}

quickbooks.invoice.get.description: Fetch a single invoice including its line items, customer, and payment status.

quickbooks.invoice.create.description: Generate a new invoice for a customer. At minimum, requires a customer reference and at least one line item.
quickbooks.invoice.create.request: Invoice fields: {CustomerRef (required - {value: id}), Line (required - [{DetailType: 'SalesItemLineDetail', Amount, SalesItemLineDetail: {ItemRef: {value: id}, UnitPrice, Qty}}]), DocNumber, TxnDate, DueDate, PrivateNote, CustomerMemo, BillAddr, ShipAddr, BillEmail, SalesTermRef, DepartmentRef, ClassRef, Deposit, ShipDate, TrackingNum, ApplyTaxAfterDiscount, TxnTaxDetail}

quickbooks.invoice.update.description: Update an existing invoice. Must include Id and SyncToken. Supports sparse updates.
quickbooks.invoice.update.request: Invoice fields to update: {Id (required), SyncToken (required), sparse (optional), CustomerRef, Line, DocNumber, TxnDate, DueDate, PrivateNote, BillAddr, ...}

quickbooks.invoice.delete.description: Permanently remove an invoice. The request must include the Id and SyncToken, and the operation=delete query parameter.

quickbooks.invoice.send.description: Email an invoice to the customer. Uses the BillEmail address on the invoice unless overridden via query parameter.

sendTo.description: Override email address to send the invoice to.

quickbooks.invoice.void.description: Void an invoice, zeroing out its balance while preserving the record for audit purposes. Include Id, SyncToken, and set void to true in the query.

quickbooks.item.get.description: Look up a single product or service item by its identifier.

quickbooks.item.create.description: Create a new product or service item. Requires Name and the appropriate account references based on item type.
quickbooks.item.create.request: Item fields: {Name (required), Type (Inventory|Service|NonInventory), Description, PurchaseDesc, Active, Taxable, UnitPrice, PurchaseCost, QtyOnHand, TrackQtyOnHand, InvStartDate, Sku, IncomeAccountRef (required for sales items), ExpenseAccountRef (required for purchase items), AssetAccountRef (required for inventory items), ParentRef, SubItem}

quickbooks.item.update.description: Modify an existing item. Must include Id and SyncToken.
quickbooks.item.update.request: Item fields to update: {Id (required), SyncToken (required), sparse (optional), Name, Type, Description, UnitPrice, PurchaseCost, QtyOnHand, Active, Taxable, ...}

quickbooks.payment.get.description: Retrieve a single customer payment record.

quickbooks.payment.update.request: Payment fields to update: {Id (required), SyncToken (required), sparse (optional), TotalAmt, Line, PaymentMethodRef, ...}

quickbooks.bill.get.description: Fetch a single bill (vendor invoice) by its identifier.

quickbooks.bill.update.request: Bill fields to update: {Id (required), SyncToken (required), sparse (optional), VendorRef, Line, DocNumber, TxnDate, DueDate, ...}

quickbooks.estimate.get.description: Retrieve a single estimate (quote/proposal) by its identifier.

quickbooks.estimate.create.description: Create a new estimate for a customer. Requires a customer reference and line items.
quickbooks.estimate.create.request: Estimate fields: {CustomerRef (required - {value: id}), Line (required), DocNumber, TxnDate, DueDate, ExpirationDate, TxnStatus, PrivateNote, CustomerMemo, BillAddr, ShipAddr, BillEmail, SalesTermRef, DepartmentRef, ClassRef, TxnTaxDetail, ApplyTaxAfterDiscount}

quickbooks.estimate.update.description: Modify an existing estimate. Must include Id and SyncToken.
quickbooks.estimate.update.request: Estimate fields to update: {Id (required), SyncToken (required), sparse (optional), CustomerRef, Line, TxnStatus, DocNumber, DueDate, ExpirationDate, ...}

quickbooks.estimate.send.description: Email an estimate to the customer using the BillEmail on the estimate or an override address.

quickbooks.purchase.create.description: Record a new expense transaction. Requires the payment account, how it was paid, and at least one expense line.
quickbooks.purchase.create.request: Purchase fields: {AccountRef (required - {value: id}), PaymentType (required - Cash|Check|CreditCard), Line (required - [{DetailType, Amount, AccountBasedExpenseLineDetail|ItemBasedExpenseLineDetail}]), DocNumber, TxnDate, PrivateNote, EntityRef, DepartmentRef, CurrencyRef, TxnTaxDetail, Credit}

quickbooks.purchase.update.request: Purchase fields to update: {Id (required), SyncToken (required), sparse (optional), AccountRef, PaymentType, Line, TxnDate, ...}

quickbooks.billpayment.get.description: Retrieve a single vendor bill payment.

quickbooks.billpayment.create.request: BillPayment fields: {VendorRef (required - {value: id}), PayType (required - Check|CreditCard), TotalAmt (required), Line (required - [{Amount, LinkedTxn: [{TxnId, TxnType: 'Bill'}]}]), TxnDate, DocNumber, APAccountRef, CheckPayment: {BankAccountRef: {value: id}}, CreditCardPayment: {CCAccountRef: {value: id}}, PrivateNote}

quickbooks.billpayment.delete.description: Permanently remove a vendor bill payment.

quickbooks.billpayment.void.description: Void a vendor payment while retaining the record.

quickbooks.creditmemo.get.description: Fetch a single credit memo by its identifier.

quickbooks.creditmemo.create.description: Issue a credit memo to a customer. Reduces the customer's outstanding balance.
quickbooks.creditmemo.create.request: CreditMemo fields: {CustomerRef (required - {value: id}), Line (required), DocNumber, TxnDate, PrivateNote, BillAddr, BillEmail, DepartmentRef, ClassRef, CurrencyRef}

quickbooks.salesreceipt.get.description: Retrieve a single sales receipt by its identifier.

quickbooks.salesreceipt.create.description: Record a point-of-sale transaction where the buyer pays immediately upon purchase.
quickbooks.salesreceipt.create.request: SalesReceipt fields: {CustomerRef (required - {value: id}), Line (required), DocNumber, TxnDate, PrivateNote, BillAddr, ShipAddr, BillEmail, PaymentMethodRef, DepositToAccountRef, DepartmentRef, ClassRef}

quickbooks.salesreceipt.send.description: Email a sales receipt to the customer.

quickbooks.purchaseorder.get.description: Fetch a single purchase order by its identifier.

quickbooks.purchaseorder.create.request: PurchaseOrder fields: {VendorRef (required - {value: id}), Line (required), DocNumber, TxnDate, DueDate, Memo, VendorAddr, ShipAddr, ShipMethodRef, DepartmentRef, ClassRef, APAccountRef, CurrencyRef}

quickbooks.purchaseorder.update.request: PurchaseOrder fields to update: {Id (required), SyncToken (required), sparse (optional), VendorRef, Line, POStatus, DueDate, Memo, ...}

quickbooks.vendorcredit.create.request: VendorCredit fields: {VendorRef (required - {value: id}), Line (required), DocNumber, TxnDate, APAccountRef, DepartmentRef, CurrencyRef}

quickbooks.deposit.create.description: Record funds deposited into a bank account from one or more sources.
quickbooks.deposit.create.request: Deposit fields: {DepositToAccountRef (required - {value: id}), Line (required), TxnDate, PrivateNote, DepartmentRef, CurrencyRef}

quickbooks.transfer.create.request: Transfer fields: {FromAccountRef (required - {value: id}), ToAccountRef (required - {value: id}), Amount (required), TxnDate, PrivateNote}

quickbooks.paymentmethod.create.description: Add a new payment method option.

filter.description: Narrow conversations by their current state.

reamaze.contacts.list.description: Retrieve all Re:amaze contacts and customers.

mailchimp.lists.members.create.description: Subscribe a new member to the audience. Returns an error 400 if the member already exists, unless the status is 'pending'.

email_address.description: Email address of the new subscriber.

status.description: Initial subscription state for this member.

email_type.description: Preferred email format for this member ('html' or 'text').

merge_fields.description: Map of merge tag keys to their values (FNAME, LNAME, etc.).

tags.description: Tags to assign to this member upon creation.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code for this subscriber.

vip.description: Whether to flag this subscriber as a VIP.

location.description: Geographic location data for the subscriber.

ip_signup.description: IP address used when the subscriber signed up.

timestamp_signup.description: ISO 8601 date and time of sign-up.

mailchimp.lists.members.get.description: Fetch details for a single audience member using their subscriber hash. Works for subscribed, unsubscribed, and bounced records.

subscriber_hash.description: MD5 hash of the member's lowercased email address, or the email address itself.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response.

exclude_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to omit from the response.

mailchimp.lists.members.list.description: Return all subscribers in a Mailchimp audience, with optional filtering by status, opt-in date, and sort preferences.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response.

exclude_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to omit from the response.

count.description: Number of records to return per page (default 10, max 1000).

offset.description: Number of records to skip before starting the page (default 0).

since_timestamp_opt.description: Limit results to members who opted in after this timestamp.

before_timestamp_opt.description: Limit results to members who opted in before this timestamp.

sort_field.description: Field name to sort results by.

sort_dir.description: Direction to sort results (ascending or descending).

mailchimp.lists.members.update.description: Update attributes such as email address, subscription status, merge fields, or VIP flag for an existing list member.

subscriber_hash.description: MD5 hash of the member's lowercased email address, or the email address itself.

email_address.description: Updated email address for this subscriber.

status.description: New subscription status for this member.

merge_fields.description: Map of merge tag keys to updated values.

language.description: Updated language preference for this subscriber.

vip.description: Updated VIP status for this subscriber.

mailchimp.lists.members.delete.description: Archive a member from the audience. The record is not permanently deleted and can be re-added later.

subscriber_hash.description: MD5 hash of the member's lowercased email address, or the email address itself.

mailchimp.lists.members.tags.description: Apply or remove tags on a list member. Tags that do not yet exist will be automatically created.

subscriber_hash.description: MD5 hash of the member's lowercased email address, or the email address itself.

name.description: Name of the tag to add or remove.

status.description: Use 'active' to add the tag or 'inactive' to remove it.

tags.description: Array of tag operations to perform on this member.

mailchimp.lists.members.notes.create.description: Add a text note to a subscriber's contact record in the audience.

subscriber_hash.description: MD5 hash of the member's lowercased email address, or the email address itself.

note.description: Text content of the note. Maximum length is 1,000 characters.

mailchimp.lists.create.description: Set up a new audience in your Mailchimp account.

name.description: Display name for the new audience.

contact.description: Company contact details shown in campaign footers to comply with anti-spam regulations.

permission_reminder.description: Opt-in reminder statement displayed to subscribers in this audience.

email_type_option.description: When true, subscribers may choose between HTML and plain-text formats; when false, only HTML is offered.

mailchimp.campaigns.create.description: Set up a new email campaign in Mailchimp.

type.description: The category of campaign to create.

recipients.description: Audience targeting configuration for the campaign.

list_id.description: Identifier of the audience to target.

subject_line.description: Subject line that will appear in recipients' inboxes.

preview_text.description: Preview snippet displayed beneath the subject line in email clients.

from_name.description: Sender name shown in the 'From' field.

reply_to.description: Address that receives any replies to this campaign.

tracking.description: Engagement tracking settings for this campaign.

mailchimp.campaigns.send.description: Dispatch a campaign that is ready to send. RSS-type campaigns follow their defined schedule; all others are delivered immediately.

campaign_id.description: Identifier of the campaign to send.

mailchimp.lists.tags.list.description: Look up tags on an audience by name. When no name is provided, all tags in the audience are returned.

name.description: Name or partial name to filter tags by.

pipefy.database.findRecords.description: Search for records within a Pipefy database table by title. Returns all matching entries along with their associated field values.

tableId.description: Identifier for the Pipefy table or database.

title.description: The title or name string to search for.

pipefy.cards.create.description: Add a new card to a Pipefy pipe, populating it with the specified field values.

pipefy.cards.move.description: Relocate a Pipefy card to another phase (column) within a pipe.

cardId.description: Identifier of the card to move.

pipefy.cards.updateField.description: Modify the value of a specific field on a Pipefy card.

cardId.description: Identifier of the card to update.

pipefy.cards.updateField.request: Body: {field_id (required, string — field ID to update), value (required, string — new field value), pipe_id (optional, string), type (optional, string — field type hint)}

monday.items.find.description: Search for an item by name on a Monday.com board. Returns the item ID required for subsequent column update operations.
monday.items.find.request: Body: {board_id (required, string — board ID), name (required, string — item name to search for)}
monday.items.find.response: {items: [{id, name, board: {id, name}, column_values: [{id, title, text, value}]}]}

monday.items.create.description: Add a new row (item) to a Monday.com board.
monday.items.create.request: Body: {board_id (required, string — board ID), item_name (required, string — name for the new item), group_id (optional, string — group/section ID to place the item in), column_values (optional, JSON string — initial column values as a JSON object mapping column IDs to values, e.g. '{"status":"Done","date4":"2024-01-15"}')}

monday.items.updateColumn.description: Set a column value for an item. Use column_type to indicate the kind of column: 'status' for status/dropdown columns, 'date' for date columns (value: YYYY-MM-DD), 'number' for numeric columns, 'text' for text columns.
monday.items.updateColumn.request: Body: {board_id (required, string — board ID), column_id (required, string — column internal ID), value (required, string — new value; for status use the label text, for date use YYYY-MM-DD, for number use a numeric string), column_type (optional, string: 'status'|'date'|'number'|'text' — helps route to the correct update function)}

gorgias.tickets.list.description: Retrieve a collection of support tickets from Gorgias. Fetch and browse helpdesk ticket records.

calendly.scheduled_events.list.description: Retrieve scheduled events (meetings, appointments, and bookings). Supports filtering by user, invitee email, date range, or status.

organization.description: Limit results to events belonging to the organization at this URI.

user.description: Limit results to events for the user at this URI. Required when organization is not provided.

invitee_email.description: Limit results to events that include the specified invitee email.

status.description: Narrow results to events with this status.

min_start_time.description: Return only events starting at or after this ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

max_start_time.description: Return only events starting before this ISO 8601 UTC timestamp.

count.description: Number of records per page (1–100, default 20).

page_token.description: Continuation token for the next page of results.

sort.description: Order results by start_time. Accepted values: 'start_time:asc' or 'start_time:desc'.

group.description: Limit results to events for the group at this URI.

calendly.scheduled_events.get.description: Fetch complete details for a single scheduled event by its UUID, including time, location, host, and invitee counts.

uuid.description: UUID of the scheduled event to retrieve.

calendly.scheduled_events.cancel.description: Cancel a scheduled event. Generates a cancellation record and sends notifications to all invitees.

uuid.description: UUID of the scheduled event to cancel.

calendly.scheduled_events.invitees.list.description: List all invitees on a scheduled event, including their booking status, contact details, and question responses.

uuid.description: UUID of the scheduled event whose invitees to list.

count.description: Number of records per page (1–100, default 20).

email.description: Narrow results to invitees matching this exact email address.

page_token.description: Continuation token for the next page of results.

status.description: Narrow results to invitees with this status.

calendly.invitee_no_shows.create.description: Flag an invitee as a no-show. Registers that the attendee did not appear for their scheduled meeting.
calendly.invitee_no_shows.create.request: Body: {invitee (required, string — full URI of the invitee, e.g. https://api.calendly.com/scheduled_events/{event_uuid}/invitees/{invitee_uuid})}

calendly.event_types.list.description: List the available meeting types and scheduling page configurations for a user or organization.

organization.description: Return event types for the organization at this URI.

user.description: Return event types for the user at this URI.

active.description: When provided, filters to only active or only inactive event types.

count.description: Number of records per page (1–100, default 20).

page_token.description: Continuation token for the next page of results.

calendly.users.get.description: Fetch a Calendly user by UUID, or supply 'me' to get the authenticated user. Returns the user's profile, scheduling URL, and timezone.

user_id.description: UUID of the user, or 'me' for the currently authenticated user.

calendly.one_off_event_types.create.description: Generate a one-time meeting link. Creates a unique scheduling URL for a standalone meeting that is not tied to a recurring event type.
calendly.one_off_event_types.create.request: {name: string, host: string, duration: integer, start_date: string, end_date: string, co_hosts: [string], timezone: string, location_kind: string, location_location: string, location_additional_info: string}

calendly.scheduling_links.create.description: Schedule a Calendly meeting by generating a booking link for an event type. When invitee_email is provided, this also creates the scheduled event and invitee record immediately (simulating a completed booking). Use this endpoint to book meetings, schedule appointments, or create events with specific invitees.
calendly.scheduling_links.create.request: Body: {max_event_count (required, integer — number of allowed bookings, typically 1), owner (required, string — event type URI or ID), owner_type (required, string — 'EventType'), invitee_email (optional, string — primary invitee email used to auto-create a scheduled event and invitee record), event_guests (optional, array of guest email strings or objects with an email field — additional attendees on that same event), name (optional, string — custom event name override, e.g. 'Vendor Site Visit - Acme Corp'), start_time (optional, string — ISO 8601 datetime for the event start), end_time (optional, string — ISO 8601 datetime for the event end)}

notion.pages.create.description: Create a new Notion page under a given parent (page or database) with specified properties. Use the children array to supply block content. For public integrations only, omit the parent to create a private workspace-level page.
notion.pages.create.request: Body: {parent (required for internal integrations, object — {type: 'page_id', page_id: '...'} or {type: 'database_id', database_id: '...'} or {workspace: true} for public integrations), properties (required, object — {title: {title: [{text: {content: 'Page Title'}}]}} for page parents, or database property values for database parents), children (optional, array — block objects for page content, max 100; mutually exclusive with markdown), content (optional, array — block objects, max 100; mutually exclusive with markdown), markdown (optional, string — page content as Notion-flavored Markdown; mutually exclusive with content/children), icon (optional, object — {type: 'emoji', emoji: '...'} or {type: 'external', external: {url: '...'}}), cover (optional, object — {type: 'external', external: {url: '...'}}), template (optional, object — {type: 'none'|'default'|'template_id', template_id (string — required when type is template_id), timezone (string — IANA timezone for template variables)}), position (optional, object)}
notion.pages.create.response: {id, object: 'page', url, public_url, created_time, last_edited_time, archived, in_trash, is_locked, parent, properties: {title: {title: [{text: {content}}]}}, icon, cover, created_by, last_edited_by}

notion.pages.update.description: Modify an existing Notion page's properties, icon, cover, archived or trash status, or locked state. A template can also be applied. Note: to add new content blocks, use the Append block children API rather than this endpoint.

page_id.description: The UUID of the page to update.

notion.pages.update.request: Body: {properties (optional, object — property values to update, e.g. {title: {title: [{text: {content: 'New Title'}}]}}), archived (optional, boolean — true to archive the page), in_trash (optional, boolean — true to move page to trash), icon (optional, object — {type: 'emoji', emoji: '...'} or {type: 'external', external: {url: '...'}}), cover (optional, object — {type: 'external', external: {url: '...'}}), is_locked (optional, boolean — lock or unlock the page from editing in the Notion app UI), template (optional, object — {type: 'default'|'template_id', template_id (string), timezone (string — IANA timezone)}), erase_content (optional, boolean — delete all existing block children before applying template)}
notion.pages.update.response: {id, object: 'page', url, public_url, archived, in_trash, is_locked, last_edited_time, properties, icon, cover, created_by, last_edited_by}
